headline: Challenger Rejects Raised $5.5 Billion Takeover Bid From Daiichi Life
summary: Australian investment manager Challenger rejected an upgraded A$8.17 billion ($5.48 billion) acquisition proposal from Japan's Daiichi Life for the remaining 79.5% stake it does not own. Challenger shares fell following the news.
why: Challenger is a prominent Australian fund manager specializing in annuities and retirement investments.

impacts.name: Challenger
impacts.why: Shares dropped after Challenger's board rejected the improved takeover proposal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The rejection of the takeover bid diminished immediate buyout premium expectations for shareholders.
